note: Only one gym day this week. Full-body once-through from 7 Sep log — slight load nudge, extra back mobility (stiff/creaky last time). No BSS. MoveU L2 W3. Train off the site even if Arnold is offline.

sessions.title: Full-Body Foundation
sessions.goal: One honest full-body hit for the week: hinge, vertical pull, push, glute, squat pattern, carry. Quality over heroics.
sessions.success: Trap bar clean and slightly stronger than 7 Sep if back allows. Pull-ups honest. Hip thrust actually loaded. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
sessions.note: Last hard data 7 Sep: trap 60×5×4 @6.5; purple-band pull-ups 6/6/6; incline 17.5×10; hip thrust 15 (underloaded — load it today); goblet 15; farmers 20. Back was stiff — warm-up mobility is not optional.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.note: Extra mobility because back felt stiff/creaky on 7 Sep. Do not rush this.

items.name: Glute Bridges
items.focus: Full squeeze. Ribs down. Prep for hip thrust.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Front shin vertical. Any under-kneecap pinch → goblet later, skip reverse lunge.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Soft lower.

items.name: Pull-up prep
items.detail: 1–2 easy sets of 3–4 purple-band or scap work
items.focus: Same purple band as 7 Sep is fine. Clean only.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 60–65 kg (open 60; 62.5–65 only if sets 1–2 are identical and back feels free)
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
exercises.note: 7 Sep: 60 across @6.5. Small nudge only if the warm-up left the back freer.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.prescription: 10–12 kg (last time 10 @ RPE 8 — hold or tiny bump if lock solid)
exercises.focus: Resist rotation. Exhale on press. Ribs stacked over pelvis.

exercises.name: Pull-up or Assisted Pull-up
exercises.prescription: Purple band (or same assist as 7 Sep). Aim clean 5–8 — stop before form breaks
exercises.focus: Full hang to chin clear. No kipping.
exercises.note: 7 Sep: purple band 6/6/6 felt good. Match or beat total clean reps. Note band colour.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.prescription: 17.5–20 kg each hand (start 17.5; 20 only if set 1 is easy)
exercises.focus: Full control. Soft landing. No bounce.

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.prescription: Load it — BB 40–60 kg or DBs ~20+ kg each. 15 kg last time was too light if glutes only hit RPE 7
exercises.focus: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Full glute squeeze at top. No lumbar overextend.
exercises.note: 7 Sep: 15 kg, glutes felt good but underloaded. Structural priority — earn real tension.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge or Goblet Squat
exercises.prescription: Prefer reverse lunge if check was clean: BW–12 kg DBs. Else goblet 16–20 kg
exercises.focus: Lunge: front shin vertical, controlled knee to floor. Goblet: depth, knees track toes.
exercises.note: 7 Sep used goblet 15. Try reverse lunge if warm-up check is clean. Name variation in notes. No BSS.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.prescription: 22–26 kg each hand (last time 20 — small bump if grip and posture allow)
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Grip finishes the set, not form collapse.

blocks.title: Conditioning
blocks.note: Optional capacity touch. Skip if flat or short on time — MoveU still happens.

items.name: Bike
items.focus: Even hard efforts. Drop or skip if energy tanks.

blocks.title: MoveU Cool-down — Lordosis L2 W3
blocks.note: Still L2 W3. Consistency > novelty. No weight. Priority after the main work.

exercises.name: Deep Tissue: All Hip
exercises.prescription: No weight — ~2–3 min video/follow-along
exercises.focus: Slow pressure. Breathe. Don't force into pain.
exercises.note: Optional if time is tight — rotations + stretch are priority.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Lift Rotations
exercises.prescription: Bodyweight only
exercises.focus: Controlled rotation. Pelvis stacked. No lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Kickback Rotations
exercises.prescription: Bodyweight only
exercises.focus: Glute drives the kickback. Ribs quiet. Smooth rotation.

exercises.name: Double Leg Hip Rotations
exercises.prescription: Bodyweight only
exercises.focus: Low back stays calm. Move from hips, not spine.

exercises.name: TFL / Glute Med Stretch
exercises.prescription: No weight — stretch hold
exercises.focus: Breathe into the outside hip. No forcing.

questions: Back today vs 7 Sep — freer after the longer warm-up, same, or still stiff?
Pull-ups — band and best clean set?
Hip thrust load used — glutes owning it?
Reverse lunge or goblet — which, and any joint noise?
